decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed erection of a first floor rear extension to the existing flat by reason of size, materials and design is considered to comply with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development); H.6.4 (Residential Extensions) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of Council's UDP, 2004 as well as Section 1 (Single storey rear extensions) and Section 2 (First floor rear extensions) of Council's Residential Extension Guidelines, 2002.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the rear elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of rear extension on first  floor to existing residential units (Turnham Green Conservation Area)
